content: Oresolo baame Jekopena wane mende manjakami nalyono lao suu pyao kakingipa sisu nyepala Jekope lamaiyuo, Dokona namba kumasasaroŋo namba wane manjiwaneme kumulyuŋu. Jepenge doko akipamo pilisi? leya.
Jekope kando gyaa kata isare sukwa pyambwakamiyasa imbwuapala lao, Namba Anatumi emba wane manja nalase lao kurapu poraipyamo dokona karose? leya.
Dokopa Oresolomeisingi lamaiyuo, Nambana kendemande wanake Bilya doko embapa palirambinyipa namba wane manjero doko suu pyao manjakaramopa nambana wane ingyuo penale, leya.
Dopa lapala banya isaru pingi enda Bilya doko kamba enda inginya lao maiyasa Jekopepa role paleyambi.
Dopa piyambisa Bilya baa wane ingiyamopa Jekopena wane mende manjakamiya.
Dokopa Oresolome lao, Anatu dokome nambapa lao rolapala karowape dee nambana pii sepala namba wane jilyamo, lapala dokona kingi Dane leya.
Oresolona kendemande enda dokome deeko wane lapo ingyuo manjakamiya.
Dokopa Oresolo baame lao, Namba kakingipa sisu andake nyuo piyambanopape nambame baa nyuo isa palyilyu lapala banya kingi Napatalai, leya.
Liyame dee kamba wane manjeronde daalyamo lao sepala banya kendemande enda Silipa nyepala Jekopeko kamba enda ingyuo nyuo maiya.
Dokopa Liyana isaru pingi enda Silipa dokome Jekopena wane mende manjakamiya.
Dokopa Liyame lao, Namba embone petamo, lapala wane banya kingi Gateleya.
Dokopa Liyana kendemande enda Silipa dokomeko dee lapo pyuo waneko manjakamiyasa dopa leya.
Namba rae maiyelyano dokona enda yango dupwame namba rae maipya larami, lapala kingi Asa leya.

Yuu mendepawiti jingi lyingi kana pyaka siyamo dokopa Liyana ikinyingi Urupene ee wandepa dokona papala bange epale amu dopalende kando nyepala rakyuo minyuo epo endangi maiya. Maiyamo kandapala Oresolo Liya lamaiyuo, Ikinyinya epale amu rakyapya dokona lapo narowale jepe, leya.

Leyamopape Liyame Oresolo kando isingi lao, Mee ingyalya ingyana pyuo nambana akali doko nyuo pupinyi kandapi dokome dee wanena epale amu dupwa kambako nyipuli lao lalyane, leya. Dokopa Oresolome lao, Ikinyinya epale amu jeramo dokona lao akali doko embapa kukwa reto palyase, lamaiya.

Dokopa alemanji Jekope isakota karo epeya dokopa Liya pao katasa karapala dopa lamaiya. Nambana wanena epale amu dupwame enda yangomaipala emba sukusa nyilyu dokona lao epapu palimbanale, leyasa dokona kukwa Jekope baapa role pyao paleyambi.
Dokopa Anatumi Liyana pii soo karapala ingi anda wane maiyamopa dokome kingi paki ingyuo Jekopena manjakamiya.
Dokopa Liyame lao, Nambana kendemande enda doko akalingi Jekope maiyunusa Anatumi wane dake kiso jilyamo, lapala kingi Isaka leya.
Lapala Liyame kambako wane ingiyamopa Jekopena wane pakinyamange ingyuo manjakamiya.

Manjipala lao, Anatumi nyisapyasa wane malu mandeyo dokome deeko pakinyamange doko konda pyuo manjo nyilyu dokona akalingimi namba lakando kingi ketae pyambwara ingilyamo, leya. Lapala wane doko kingi Sepyulane leya.
Enakanadee kamba wanake manjipala kingi Daina leya.
Dee dokona Anatumi Oresolona pii soo suu pyao karapala kurapu pau lakamiya.
Dopa piyamopa wane ingiyasa manjipala lao, Ingi porayamosa namba keta pii paleyamo doko Anatumi nyuo nembakapya, leya.
Dee Kamongo dokome wane mendeko konda pyuojipyali yaka lapala banya kingi Josepe leya.
Jekope Panga Soo Yulu Lapo Piya
Oresolome Josepe manjo nyepeyamo dokopa Jekopeme Lapane lamaiyuo, Nambana anda yuupi range dokona panyaŋa mapanyi nemba, leya.
Nambame embena yulu rolae pyakao kareyo kande doko. Nambana enda wanepena lao yulu pyakayosa piyaŋa dupwa nyuo parowale, leya.
Leyamopape Lapaneme isingi lamaiyuo, Embame dokona palyuo nambame mende lapili lao lare ramo doko nambame kandapunu dokopa Kamongo dokome embapa lapolapo lao namba elyape keta pisipyamo karo.
Yole bange dokore jii lao larenepa kapa jerowale, leya.
Dokopa Jekopeme lao, Emba soo karene doko nambame embena yulu pyakao dee mena bulamakao dupwa andanyi nembako pipu kandapi.

Namba epapa nayono dokopa kuki lama iki minyiipya kande. Namba dae epapala pyuo kareyono palusa Kamongo dokome mena wai kiso kaiya karapala emba pyuo ketae nembeya. Dopa piyunupape nambana anda range wambu dupwa apa pyuo nyisarose? leya.
Lapaneme lao, Nambame aki emba joowase? leya. Dokopa Jekopeme, Mende jerende daaŋa. Mende laronuli pyuo pyakare ramo doko nambame embena mena dupwa deeko nenge pyakao kararowale.
Nambame embena mena dupwa kandala papipala sipisipi kombe kambe singi dupwape ikyane pupuri dupwape dee meme kombe kambe singi dupwape yapo nyuo nambana yole ingyuo nyero.

Dokopa nambame yulu rolae pyuo mende waa nyaka nao kararonde ramo dokoenakana panara. Embame enakana namba range nyereli dupwa kandala eparene dokopamena mee dupwana mende pyambwaro ramo dokopa nambame waa ingyuo nyakaelyamo laokandare ingilyamo, leya.
Lapaneme lao, Keyange ingyalyamo. Dokona palyuo pimbana, leya.
Dokopa Lapaneme mena meme kalyuwa dee inyape kombe kambe soo kalya pyuo pingi dupwape dee mena sipisipi ikyane pupuri dupwape yapo nyepala ikinyingi dupwame rapu pyuo lanyuo pena leya.
Dopa pyuo mena dupwa yuu nanesa minyuo karala pyambuya. Yuu remasa katasa palyuo peyamopa Jekopeme doloma rapu pyakamyuo kareya.
Dokopa Jekopeme isa kyaka wakale dupwa pokapala kanya kewa lena lao yanenge dusa kalapa dasa kalapa piya.

Dokopa isa rekya lalya lana pinyi nembeya dupwa nyepala mena ipwa nala epenge isa luku luku pisi dupwana kanda kanda kareya. Mena dupwame pinginyili pyuo ipwa nala epo dokopa kalyuwa dupwame inya nyingi.
Nyuo dokopa isa kalya pisi dupwa kandapala dokopa yakane kalya pingipi kombe kambe singipi manjira ingiya.

Dokopa Jekopeme sipisipi liti pyuo nyepala inya dupwame kokwa dupwape kalya pingipi pupuri dupwape kandaro sinya lao kareya. Dopa pyuo banya rangena dupwa Lapanena dupwana role pyao kara napala malu mee wakale ingyuo nyiya.
Dee mena inya andengena dupwa kalyuwame nyiyamo dokopa Jekopeme ipwa dokona isa dupwa kandaraminyi sinya lao pano reteya.
Dee koole dupwa nyiyamo dokopa isa dupwa nyuo reta naya. Dokopa mena porai dupwa Jekopena ingyuo peyamopa koo dupwa Lapanena ingiya.
Dopako pyuo kareyamosa Jekope baa kamongapala mena malu minyuo kendemande enda akalipi wakasa karo dee mena kamele osepe dupwame kaiya kareya.
